verses.html: 1 Then Jesus left that place and went into the region of Judea, beyond the Jordan. Again the crowds came to Him and He taught them, as was His custom.
verses.text: 1 Then Jesus left that place and went into the region of Judea, beyond the Jordan. Again the crowds came to Him and He taught them, as was His custom.

verses.html: 2 Some Pharisees came to test Him. “Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife?” they inquired.
verses.text: 2 Some Pharisees came to test Him. “Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife?” they inquired.

verses.html: 3 “What did Moses command you?” He replied.
verses.text: 3 “What did Moses command you?” He replied.

verses.html: 4 They answered, “Moses permitted a man to write his wife a certificate of divorce and send her away.”
verses.text: 4 They answered, “Moses permitted a man to write his wife a certificate of divorce and send her away.”

verses.html: 5 But Jesus told them, “Moses wrote this commandment for you because of your hardness of heart.
verses.text: 5 But Jesus told them, “Moses wrote this commandment for you because of your hardness of heart.

verses.html: 6 However, from the beginning of creation, ‘God made them male and female.’
verses.text: 6 However, from the beginning of creation, ‘God made them male and female.’

verses.html: 7 ‘For this reason a man will leave his father and mother and be united to his wife,
verses.text: 7 ‘For this reason a man will leave his father and mother and be united to his wife,

verses.html: 8 and the two will become one flesh.’ So they are no longer two, but one flesh.
verses.text: 8 and the two will become one flesh.’ So they are no longer two, but one flesh.

verses.html: 9 Therefore what God has joined together, let man not separate.”
verses.text: 9 Therefore what God has joined together, let man not separate.”

verses.html: 10 When they were back inside the house, the disciples asked Jesus about this matter.
verses.text: 10 When they were back inside the house, the disciples asked Jesus about this matter.

verses.html: 11 So He told them, “Whoever divorces his wife and marries another woman commits adultery against her.
verses.text: 11 So He told them, “Whoever divorces his wife and marries another woman commits adultery against her.

verses.html: 12 And if a woman divorces her husband and marries another man, she commits adultery.”
verses.text: 12 And if a woman divorces her husband and marries another man, she commits adultery.”

verses.html: 1 After that, Jesus {and his apprentices} left the town of Capernaum. They traveled to the region of Judea and to the east side of the Jordan River. Yet again, large groups of people assembled where Jesus was. Jesus instructed them, as he usually did.
verses.text: 1 After that, Jesus {and his apprentices} left the town of Capernaum. They traveled to the region of Judea and to the east side of the Jordan River. Yet again, large groups of people assembled where Jesus was. Jesus instructed them, as he usually did.

verses.html: 2 Then some Pharisees came to Jesus and asked him, “Does our law allow a husband to divorce his wife?” {They asked that} in order to investigate him.
verses.text: 2 Then some Pharisees came to Jesus and asked him, “Does our law allow a husband to divorce his wife?” {They asked that} in order to investigate him.

verses.html: 3 Jesus replied, “What did Moses include in our Law {about this issue}?”
verses.text: 3 Jesus replied, “What did Moses include in our Law {about this issue}?”

verses.html: 4 They answered, “Moses allowed each husband to give {his wife} a document that states that he is divorcing her. Then, he could divorce her.”
verses.text: 4 They answered, “Moses allowed each husband to give {his wife} a document that states that he is divorcing her. Then, he could divorce her.”

verses.html: 5 Jesus told them, “Moses knew that you were unwilling to obey. That is why he included {in the Law} what you just said.
verses.text: 5 Jesus told them, “Moses knew that you were unwilling to obey. That is why he included {in the Law} what you just said.

verses.html: 6 However, when God first created everything, {as you can read in the Scriptures}, he created people to be male and female.
verses.text: 6 However, when God first created everything, {as you can read in the Scriptures}, he created people to be male and female.

verses.html: 7 {You can also read in the Scriptures} that is why men{, when they marry,} no longer live with their parents,
verses.text: 7 {You can also read in the Scriptures} that is why men{, when they marry,} no longer live with their parents,

verses.html: 8 and each husband and wife together become like one person. Consequently, each husband and wife are not like two different people any longer. Rather, they are like one person.
verses.text: 8 and each husband and wife together become like one person. Consequently, each husband and wife are not like two different people any longer. Rather, they are like one person.

verses.html: 9 Since that is true, no one should divide people whom God has united.”
verses.text: 9 Since that is true, no one should divide people whom God has united.”

verses.html: 10 Later, when they were in a house again, the apprentices asked Jesus about what he had said.
verses.text: 10 Later, when they were in a house again, the apprentices asked Jesus about what he had said.

verses.html: 11 Jesus told them, “When a man divorces his wife and marries another woman, he sins against his first wife by disobeying what God commanded about being sexually faithful to one’s spouse.
verses.text: 11 Jesus told them, “When a man divorces his wife and marries another woman, he sins against his first wife by disobeying what God commanded about being sexually faithful to one’s spouse.

verses.html: 12 Also, when a woman divorces her husband and marries another man, she disobeys what God commanded about being sexually faithful to one’s spouse.”
verses.text: 12 Also, when a woman divorces her husband and marries another man, she disobeys what God commanded about being sexually faithful to one’s spouse.”
